feed.headline: Head coach Jesse Minter said Monday that Jackson is "definitely doing better" in his recovery from a sprained left ankle, Jamison Hensley of ESPN.com reports.
feed.story: Jackson was held out of Sunday's 30-23 overtime win over the Falcons due to a left ankle sprain. Minter added that he wasn't sure whether Jackson would be cleared to practice Wednesday.

feed.headline: Lamb is believed to be dealing with a "quad bruise" that is "not considered to be serious," Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
feed.story: Lamb was deemed questionable to return to Thursday's loss after taking a hit on the same quad that got hit last week. He does not appear to be facing an extended absence.
